data.narrative:
Strand Therapeutics is a Series B-stage biotech company in the Biotech & Health sector that has raised $205M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer universe of 8 private and 3 public comparables, with same-sector and same/adjacent-stage private peers including Eikon Therapeutics ($539M Series B), Chai Discovery ($3.8B Series C), New Limit ($3.1B Series C), and Colossal Biosciences ($10.3B Series C).

Two valuation methods are applicable. Stage-progression analysis applies a typical Series B step-up multiplier of 1.9x to the $205M raised proxy, implying $390M. Peer-median analysis across the 4 private comparables yields a median valuation of $3.5B, with a range spanning $539M to $10.3B. Public-comp anchoring (sector P/S median 9.2x across RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) cannot be applied due to absence of target revenue disclosure, standard for private companies.

The triangulated range is $331M to $4.0B, with a median of $1.9B across the two applicable methods. The wide dispersion reflects material stage and progress heterogeneity within the peer set; Eikon at $539M represents a lower-stage comparable, while Colossal and Chai at $3.1B–$10.3B reflect more advanced-stage trajectories. Key uncertainties include clinical or product development inflection points specific to Strand and whether the peer set adequately reflects Strand's technical risk profile.
